title: A Sharper Certified Lower Bound for Erdos' Minimum-Overlap Problem
description:
Proof note and frozen computer-assisted proof package for the lower bound c_E > 0.38056070 for Erdos' minimum-overlap constant.

The proof retains Liam Price's certified Arb bounds for 170 noncentral mean bins and replaces the two binding center bins. The authoritative center proof object is a standalone finite-decimal combined certificate: one second-moment multiplier, 80 ordinary cosine multipliers, one positive weighted-Parseval budget, and 400 combined harmonic coefficients. Exact rational validation checks that every combined coefficient satisfies the condition needed for a decomposition into a valid weighted Parseval row and nonnegative exact-harmonic rows.

The center integral is then certified by a direct-MPFR/C verifier using directed rounding, sixth-order Taylor enclosures, a seventh-derivative remainder, and exact aggregation of the 32 rigorous chunk bounds. The LP/frequency search and historical Python interval experiments are outside the trusted proof path. This release is not an external third-party audit.
